desc: Introducing the GLOCK Tactical Light II (GTL II), a familiar accessory with a new design and optimized features for maximum efficiency. Specially designed for GLOCK pistols with a mounting rail. This new LED pistol light provides ~600 lumens for bright illumination and ~11,100 Candela for light concentration. The GTL II features a high-quality aluminum housing with characteristic GLOCK serrations for better grip, seamlessly blending into the pistol design. It is precisely matched to the length and width of the G19/G45 slide, offering optimal handling and comfort, whether carried or holstered.
